note: A 4 x 6 x 8 box with a hole of diameter 5 through its z faces. The cylinder (r = 5/2) clears the y faces but not the x faces (|x| = 2): it takes from each z face the disc cut at x = +-2, area R = 4 (3/2 + (r^2 / 2) asin(4/5)) = 6 + 12.5 asin(0.8), and a strip of chord 3 from each x face; its wall is two arcs of r (pi - 2 acos(0.8)). The hole spans the box from the y = 3/2 cut to the y = -3/2 one, so it leaves two pieces; each z face and each x face is two faces, 12 in all.
